svg.text: How paging works: watch three requests grow, one finish, and a new one reuse its memory
Each request keeps a block table (logical block to physical block). Blocks need not be contiguous, so nothing is wasted or fragmented.

g.text: B finished: its 3 blocks go back to the free pool

svg.text: Illustration of the mechanism (src/pagedserve block manager). Not a measurement.
